warmups.prompt: Summarize the trade-off between caching more data in RAM and reading it from NVMe on demand. Include one failure mode of each approach.
warmups.text:
The core trade-off between caching more data in RAM versus reading from NVMe on demand balances **latency** against **capacity and cost**.

RAM offers significantly lower latency (nanoseconds) and higher IOPS than even the fastest NVMe drives (microseconds), making it ideal for hot data that requires instant access.
